title: First-run optimizer visual suite: infographics, screenshot atlas, and microcopy for batch/cache/quant
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a cohesive, first-run visual suite to surface optimizer recommendations (batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization) in the product onboarding and docs. Deliverables: 1 hero interpretive infographic, a screenshot atlas with 6 annotated frames (desktop + mobile variants), concise in-product microcopy for each recommendation, 3 explainer GIFs demonstrating batching and cache effects, and an export-ready asset pack (SVG, PNG@2x, source Figma file). Focus on clarity for engineers while retaining product-brand voice.
acceptance_criteria: Hero infographic explains when to enable batching, KV caching, and quantization in <= 3 visual steps
Screenshot atlas includes 6 annotated frames covering: optimizer home, recommendation card expanded, quantization selector, batching slider, cache preview, and in-context cost/latency comparison
All microcopy reviewed and approved by Content UX (Sara Kim) and PM (Diego Martinez)
Assets exported in SVG and PNG@2x with documented export specs and naming conventions
Figma file handed off to engineering with comments linked to ENG-5201 and ENG-5299
Documentation PR includes at least 3 screenshots from the atlas and 2 GIFs demonstrating speed/cost tradeoffs

progress_updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff with Diego (PM), Kai (Eng) and Sara (Content). Agreed on three hero directions: Timeline, Flow + Metrics, and Scenario-first. Decided to prioritize Flow + Metrics for clarity to engineers.
2026-03-02: Delivered 3 rough hero sketches. Stakeholders preferred 'Flow + Metrics' and requested a simplified visual for non-technical viewers. Action: reduce technical jargon in hero microcopy.
2026-03-05: Completed high-fidelity frames for desktop. Produced initial microcopy for recommendation cards. PM requested explicit CTA copy variants for both self-serve and enterprise customers.

2026-03-08: UX review: Sara suggested shortening quantization explanation to two bullets and adding a tooltip pattern. Engineering flagged that quantization options differ by model family; we added 'model-specific note' slot in designs.

2026-03-10: Design iteration 2 ready. Prepared GIF prototypes showing batching latency smoothing and cache hit preview. Uploaded assets to Drive for stakeholder preview. Next: finalize export specs and prepare screenshot atlas.
review_notes: PM (Diego): tighten microcopy to '3 outcomes' messaging: latency, cost, stability
Content UX (Sara): avoid 'quantize' verb in user-facing text; use 'enable optimized model profile' with a short explainer

Security: no PII surfaced in screenshots; confirm logs / request IDs are redacted in atlas before PR
decisions: Pick 'Flow + Metrics' hero direction to convey tradeoffs visually
Use compact microcopy style: 1-line headline + 1-line explain + 1 action CTA
Include both desktop and mobile variants for each screenshot to support docs and in-console modals
Embed a small 'why this matters' tooltip pattern for each recommendation rather than long in-line copy
